'''Sturdy leather boots''' are the [[Sturdy leather armor|sturdy leather]] [[Armor#Boots|boots]], crafted from 4 [[sturdy leather]]. Sturdy leather armor is a light set built against arrows and falls.

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===

=== Chest loot ===

== Usage ==

=== Armor ===
They give 2 armor with 350 durability and 2 blocks of safe fall distance, twice what leather gives. Projectile Protection II comes on the item as an ordinary enchantment. They also have Feather Falling II, the [[Trailblaze]] intrinsic, and 1 extra block of step height, which lets the wearer walk up full blocks without jumping.

=== Repairing ===
They can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[tattered leather]]. The pack resets repair costs to zero, so they can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].
